chunks: And from him, from Safwan, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
When the woman is divorced and she is pregnant, her term is that she gives birth to her pregnancy, and even if she gives birth immediately.

key_terms.تَضَعَ حَمْلَهَا: she gives birth to her pregnancy

ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a pregnant woman after divorce?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that the 'iddah of a pregnant woman concludes with the actual delivery of the child, a ruling derived directly from the Quranic verse 'and for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth.' This principle ensures the woman's status is resolved immediately upon birth, whether it occurs shortly after divorce or after a longer gestation, highlighting the practical flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding the termination of the waiting period.

en.hubeali:
And from him, from Safwan, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>
having said: ‘When the woman is divorced and she is pregnant, so her term is that she places her load (gives birth), even if she were to places it within an hour’.
en.sarwar: 11. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Safwan from Musa ibn Bakr from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
If a woman is divorced when she is pregnant her waiting period is childbirth even if she gives birth in the same hour.’”
